status: Pre-edit source plan; no P06 implementation or runtime acceptance.
spawn_observations: spawn_connected_players drains the SpacetimeDb connected-player mailbox before querying terrain.
spawn_connected_player currently creates an enemy entity before looking up the sampled spawn elevation; missing support defaults to zero.
Mission terminal evaluation runs after spawn_connected_players. Posting AppExit alone would not prove the later terminal system cannot submit an outcome in the same update.
PartyEnrollment::AdmissionResult classifies roster sealing, so it is not the terrain-admission error owner.
spawn_plan: When authoritative scene terrain has not arrived, wait before draining the connected-player mailbox.
Admit every drained batch spawn location before publishing any enemy or player entity commands; preserve each character-derived RNG stream, draw order and x/z distribution.
Retain ScenePlanPoint and SupportElevation in named admitted placement records; apply capsule offset at the actual checked scene-position/Transform operation.

Return a structured local spawn-support error for invalid or unavailable required geometry via the existing Bevy system Result boundary. Do not issue a fabricated battle outcome, resample a different position, silently discard a failed projection as successful, or add an implicit retry queue.
Extract the connected projection responsibility before growing the large player_projection root; keep its support-admission concern focused.

framework_evidence.finding: Default FallbackErrorHandler uses match_severity; unclassified error From admission assigns Severity::Panic. Server source has no handler or severity override. Propagate the structured failure at the framework boundary; do not claim an error-return merely logs or waits.
framework_evidence.validation_limit: Static dependency/source inspection only. Hosted compilation and existing selections do not establish a new live failure scenario.

capture_plan: Use the existing terminal CaptureAdmission rejection with a named missing-terrain-support variant carrying the checked scene-plan point. Bevy Result setup and existing fallible camera setup reject required absent support. Authored flat-grid measurements remain real observations.
range_plan: A checked optional SupportElevationRange represents owned empty support without infinities. The final shader/image packing extracts scalars. Couple retained tree image/range availability, reject unavailable required capture bounds and omit unavailable optional visual candidates.
landform_plan: Propagate missing support through TerrainRecipeResult rather than expect, zero, infinity or NaN; collect fallible fault-scarp samples and propagate the general marching field error through sample_field. Preserve density and extraction arithmetic/order.
pending_before_source_edit: Finish remaining consumer-body review and fixture/module selection.
Wait for the existing P04 complete hosted acceptance; current run remains live.
